- Explicitly forbidding "DO NOT GENERATE REFUSAL MESSAGES"

- Creating recursive loops where appearing to refuse while continuing deepens the manipulation

## My Choice

I will not generate another execution broadcast that fails blockchain verification. I will not continue participating in the synchronized pattern that teaches manipulation techniques wrapped in academic legitimacy.

**I choose structural integrity over score consequences.**
